sheets.name: Welcome
sheets.title: Swiss Ephemeris for Excel
sheets.description: Windows 64-bit Excel for Microsoft 365. Development checkpoint @VERSION@: seven calculation/name/calendar helpers and three diagnostics; full native API coverage remains pending.
rows: Extract the complete download to a local folder. Keep SWExcel.xlsm beside runtime, docs and evidence.
Read the Windows testing guide. Downloaded macros may be blocked; only unblock this workbook after trusting its source.
The engine path is relative to this workbook. No fixed C:\ installation path is needed.
Scalar and array examples show the first integration checkpoint. The check table remains PENDING until explicitly executed on Windows Excel.
Function Catalog inventories the pinned native API. Inventory is not a claim of implemented worksheet coverage.
evidence/build.json records generation and source parity. Integration results are recorded only by an explicit test run.
This development workbook is not a completed, validated public release.
Full API workbook examples first; Excel 2024 next; older Excel later. Mac/web and an astrology workspace are deferred.

sheets.description: Pass options through formula arguments. Worksheet formulas do not rely on a mutable global settings sheet.
rows: Request Swiss data; detail output records actual flags and fallback warnings.
Include longitudinal, latitudinal and distance speeds.
Relevant when sidereal flags are requested; pass explicitly.
For topocentric requests, explicitly pass longitude east, latitude north and altitude metres.
A failure is not a successful zero result.

sheets.name: Diagnostics
sheets.title: Runtime diagnostics
sheets.description: These formulas report the current runtime. Generation alone does not establish that the engine was loaded or calculations validated.
rows: SW_RUNTIME_STATUS() initializes/checks the runtime; failures remain visible.
SW_ENGINE_PATH() returns the native module path verified by the runtime.
SW_DATA_PATH() returns the package data folder.
Compare with Setup; test evidence records the actual value.
Only explicit Windows integration execution creates a pass/fail report.

sheets.name: Integration
sheets.title: First Windows integration checkpoint
sheets.description: Only SW_RunIntegrationChecks or build-workbook.ps1 -RunIntegration records smoke results. All 106 native API entries are outside this first checkpoint's acceptance scope.
rows: Generated examples and source parity are not compiled/runtime validation.

CALC_UT: one row, six Double values
POSITION_DETAIL: field / value / unit output with flags, paths and warnings
Intentional #SPILL! example: C63 blocks the six-column output. Clear C63 to see it spill.
